summary: Tested Electron app launch after nohoist fix. Build succeeds but runtime fails because pnpm doesn't support nohoist configuration. The electron package exists in frontend node_modules but pnpm's module resolution causes issues at runtime.
current_status: Electron build works (vite compiles successfully) but runtime fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'isPackaged')' error. Root cause: project uses pnpm but nohoist only works with npm/yarn.
next_steps: Decide on pnpm fix approach: .npmrc with shamefully-hoist, OR public-hoist-pattern, OR switch to npm/yarn
blockers: pnpm doesn't support nohoist configuration - need different approach for Electron workspaces
